an5.35:1.1: “Bhikkhus, there are these five benefits of giving.
an5.35:1.3: (1) One is dear and agreeable to many people.
an5.35:1.6: (4) One is not deficient in the layperson’s duties.
an5.35:1.7: (5) With the breakup of the body, after death, one is reborn in a good destination, in a heavenly world.
an5.35:1.8: These are the five benefits in giving.”
an5.35:2.2: one follows the duty of the good;
an5.35:2.4: the good self-controlled monks always resort to one.
an5.35:3.4: the taintless one here attains nibbāna.
